question: Which level of the Panchayati Raj system operates at the village level?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gram Panchayat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Gram Panchayat** is the foundational level of the Panchayati Raj system and operates at the village level.
 
• It is responsible for local governance and addressing issues within a village or group of villages.
 
• The Gram Panchayat is elected by the **Gram Sabha**, which consists of all the eligible voters in the village.
 
• The head of the Gram Panchayat is known as the **Sarpanch**, who is elected directly by the villagers.
 
• Key responsibilities include implementing rural development programs, maintaining village infrastructure, and ensuring the welfare of the residents.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Panchayati Raj System:** It is a three-tier system of governance in India, consisting of Gram Panchayat (village level), Panchayat Samiti (block level), and Zila Parishad (district level).
 
• **Gram Sabha:** The Gram Sabha is the assembly of all eligible voters in a village, and it serves as the decision-making body that oversees the functioning of the Gram Panchayat.
 
• **73rd Constitutional Amendment:** This amendment, passed in 1992, provided constitutional status to the Panchayati Raj institutions and ensured decentralized governance.
 
• **Functions of Gram Panchayat:** These include maintaining water supply, sanitation, roads, and public health; executing development schemes; and resolving disputes at the village level.
 
• **Revenue Sources:** Gram Panchayats generate revenue through taxes on property, markets, and local businesses, as well as grants from the state government.
